data.explanation: This is your policy confirmation for home contents insurance. Cover starts on 1 October 2026 for one year. The contract renews by one year each time unless you cancel in text form (for example by e-mail or letter) at least three months before the end of the insurance year. The first premium of €96.60 will be collected by direct debit at the start of the contract, so make sure your account has enough money. Keep this document with your insurance papers.
